name: [SOON] Retro Circus
desc:
Step into a wild circus adventure inspired by The Amazing Digital Circus! Explore, survive, and thrive in a world where the show never ends.

FEATURES:  
• Mini‑adventures solo or with friends — earn StarPoints & unlock characters
• Play as unique performers with special abilities
• Build & decorate your own circus room
• Create custom adventures for other players
• Daily rewards, missions & streak bonuses
• Sanity system — stay sane, stay alive
• Progression system with milestone rewards & session bonuses

RETENTION UPDATE:  
• Faster intro & improved onboarding
• Objective tracker + floating world markers
• Shorter intermissions (max 30s)
• Pop‑up reward notifications
• Server merging + solo‑player detection
• Performance & bug fixes

MONETIZATION UPDATES:  
• VIP (300 Robux): 1.5x StarPoints, daily 50 bonus, gold tag
• Lucky Charm (200 Robux): 2x StarPoints
• Speed Demon (200 Robux): 1.5x walk speed
• New booster packs, reward bundles & premium milestone rewards
• And more
